report:
Oral cavity, right mandible, segmental mandibulectomy and neck dissection

Received in formalin is a segmental mandibulectomy specimen measuring 80 x 45 x 35 mm. The specimen is orientated: suture at the anterior bone cut. There is an ulcerated tumour in the right mandible measuring 35 x 25 x 12 mm, 8 mm from the closest (posterior soft tissue) margin. The margins are inked. The bone is decalcified. Representative sections are taken in 16 blocks.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Segmental mandibulectomy and neck dissection
- Tumour site: Lower alveolus and gingiva, right
- Tumour size: 35 mm (greatest dimension)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Squamous cell carcinoma, conventional (keratinising)
- Histologic grade: G2, moderately differentiated
- Tumour histology:
  The tumour is a moderately differentiated keratinising squamous cell carcinoma, invading to a depth of 12 mm. Infiltrating nests and cords of atypical squamous cells show intercellular bridges and focal keratinisation, with moderate nuclear pleomorphism, in a desmoplastic stroma.
- Depth of invasion: 12 mm
- Tumour extent: No other adjacent structure involved
- Bone invasion: Present
  - Pattern: Infiltrative
  - Level: Medullary (through the cortex)
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Present, extratumoural

Margins
- Invasive tumour: All margins negative
  - Closest margin: 8 mm (posterior soft tissue)
- High grade dysplasia / carcinoma in situ: Margins uninvolved

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: 28 examined; 1 involved
  - Extranodal extension: Present, major (more than 2 mm from the capsule); 3 mm
  - Size of largest metastatic deposit: 22 mm, level IB
  - Laterality: Ipsilateral (including midline)
  - By level: level IB 1/4, level IIA 0/6, level III 0/9, level IV 0/9

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT4a pN2a

Additional findings
- None identified

ORAL CAVITY, right mandible, segmental mandibulectomy and neck dissection
- SQUAMOUS CELL CARCINOMA, moderately differentiated, 35 mm, invading to a depth
  of 12 mm; medullary bone invasion; perineural invasion present
  (extratumoural); completely excised (closest margin 8 mm, posterior soft
  tissue); see synoptic report
- 1 of 28 regional lymph nodes involved; extranodal extension present (major)
- pT4a pN2a (AJCC 8th edition)
